info.title: Draconis Labs API
info.description: Versioned REST API for Draconis Labs. Prefer /api/v1 paths; unversioned /api paths are deprecated.

bearerAuth.description: Named API key (Bearer token) for agent identity. Planner keys have no per-operation scopes.

nextCursor.description: Pass this value as cursor on the next request. Null marks the last page.

parameters.name: pagination
parameters.description: Select cursor pagination on the first request. Omit page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor from the previous page. Repeat the same filters and omit page.
